simple.meaning: שָׁבַח (shâbach) is a Hebrew word meaning “properly, to address in a loud tone , i.e. (specifically) loud ; figuratively, to pacify (as if by words).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: שָׁבַח (H7623) appears 11 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 1 Chronicles 16:35, with occurrences in 1 Chronicles, Psalms, Proverbs, Ecclesiastes.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁבַח (H7623) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שָׁבַח (H7623) before moving outward to related references.

occurrences.englishText: Say, “Save us, God of our salvation!
So I will bless you while I live.
They also who dwell in faraway places are afraid at your wonders.
You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain.
One generation will commend your works to another,
A fool vents all of his anger,
Therefore I praised the dead who have been long dead more than the living who are yet alive.

Then I commended mirth, because a man has no better thing under the sun, than to eat, and to drink, and to be joyful: for that will accompany him in his labor all the days of his life which God has given him under the sun.
